newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soybeans hit double-digit gains on funds.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soybeans hit double-digit gains on funds.

text.p: CBOT July soybean futures posted double-digit gains in fast dealings on aggressive fund buying tied to belief the week's sharp losses were overdone, pit sources said.

Funds bought at least 10 million bushels, led by Refco Inc. Trade sources said Refco bought at least three million bushels July, R.J. O'Brien bought 2.6 million July and Rosenthal Collins bought three million November.
At 1215 CDT, soybeans were up 10 to 1-3/4 cents per bushel with July up 7-1/4 at $8.65.
